excluded_reference_samples.reason: Uses Mobius GTO ranges; retain as a separate reference and exclude from standard-range averages.

averaging_rules.scope: Per-exact-combo trainer targets for top pair, middle pair, and unpaired hands.
averaging_rules.board_weighting: Equal weight among included boards; range weights establish presence, not board weight.
averaging_rules.eligibility: Combo must be legal and have positive node reach weight. Made-hand class, flush draw, backdoor flush draw, direct straight-draw type, and backdoor straight status must remain identical.
averaging_rules.subset_selection: Largest stable-profile board subset, at least two boards. Ties favor the subset appearing first in AK5, AK4, AK3, AK2 order.
averaging_rules.excluded_boards: Omitted from both numerator and denominator, never treated as zero; exclusion reasons shown per combo.
averaging_rules.rounding: Compute the mean from original frequencies, then round once to nearest whole percent (half up).
averaging_rules.suit_handling: Each exact suited or offsuit combo has its own target; blocked and zero-weight combos are omitted.
averaging_rules.frequency_spread: Maximum minus minimum among included board frequencies, in percentage points. Wide-spread visual highlight starts at 15 pp.

average_target_implementation: src/average-trainer.js; calculated at runtime from saved standard-Xeno samples
